text:
Nina (Product): quick sync: we need a single, predictable error surface for clients and console before next weeks dev preview. high level goals: machine-friendly codes, stable numeric ids, and friendly ui copy.

Theo (Platform Eng): agree. propose 3-layer contract: http_status (transport), code (dashed string), id (short int). apps should rely on id or code, not message text.

Priya (Console): console shows whatever the API returns today. we need a mapping table: bucket -> banner copy -> severity -> docs link. can we lock canonical banner strings so console UX is consistent?

Alex (SDK): SDKs can add helpers like Error.isRetryable() and Error.severity(). but the wire format needs to be tiny. suggest fields: status, code, id, bucket, summary, details(optional), retry_after(optional).

Diego (SRE): telemetry constraint: do not put raw model names in high-card fields. mandatory tags: bucket, code, id, region, service. also: attach sample=true for replayed errors so we can test dashboards.

Maya (Design): microcopy pattern: one-line summary + one action hint. ex: "Requests exceeded your plan limit." / "Try smaller batches or request Dedicated capacity." short and imperative.

Nina (Product): draft bucket list: throttling, auth, client_input, infra_transient, not_found, blocked_safety. each maps to a default http status but not strictly bound.

Theo (Platform Eng): we need to handle hybrid cases. example: model file missing -> bucket:not_found, code:model_missing, id:2003, status:404. But some 5xx will be infra_transient; others terminal. code subspace should indicate terminal vs retryable e.g. "retry.gpu_eviction" vs "terminal.model_corrupt".

Alex (SDK): numeric id please. many infra rules and wafs only support numeric comparison. propose we reserve 1000-1999 for client errors, 2000-2999 for infra/serving, 3000-3999 for quota/auth.

Priya (Console): visual severity mapping proposal: info(blue)=infra_transient, warn(yellow)=throttling, danger(red)=auth & blocked_safety, neutral(gray)=client_input/not_found. keep colors minimal.

Diego (SRE): alerts: define SLO-based thresholds per-bucket. e.g. sustained infra_transient > 0.5% calls in 5m -> pager. throttling spikes -> capacity team paging.

Maya (Design): sample banner text suggestions:
- throttling: "Request limit reached" / action: "Reduce parallel requests or upgrade plans."
- auth: "Authentication failed" / action: "Check your API key and permissions."
- client_input: "Invalid request" / action: "Verify request fields."
- safety: "Content blocked for safety" / action: "Modify content or contact support."

Nina (Product): draft structured payload example:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "status": 429,
    "id": 3021,
    "code": "quota.project_monthly_limit",
    "bucket": "throttling",
    "summary": "Request limit reached.",
    "details": "Exceeded monthly quota for project.",
    "retry_after": 120
  }
}
```

Theo (Platform Eng): prefer code style with dots not underscores. also rename details -> developer_message to clarify not meant for end-user UI. summary is UI copy.

Alex (SDK): hoisting: SDKs will expose both summary and developer_message. summary -> displayed in console and app banners by default. developer_message -> logs for debugging.

Priya (Console): for rollout: feature flag on console that translates bucket/code->badge+summary. will add a preview mode that shows mapping across examples.

Diego (SRE): backwards compat: for 8 weeks we return legacy_message alongside new structure: legacy_message for clients that still parse text. then emit deprecation headers.

Maya (Design): question: should console auto-translate some codes to inline hints? e.g. throttling -> show "Reduce batch size" inline with example code snippets. keep it optional behind flag.

Theo (Platform Eng): implementation notes: server-side helpers will be in platform-lib. sample builder snippet:
```
PlatformError::new(429)
  .with_id(3021)
  .with_code("quota.project_monthly_limit")
  .with_bucket("throttling")
  .with_summary("Request limit reached")
  .with_dev_message("Exceeded monthly quota for project id=abc")
  .with_retry_after(120)
```

Alex (SDK): migration: SDKs will accept both raw string errors and structured payload. will add lint warnings to repos that parse messages.

Nina (Product): rollout checklist (tentative):
- spec PR + examples in api-spec repo
- server helper libs + numeric id registry
- console feature flag + preview mappings
- SDK updates (py/js/go)
- telemetry tags + dashboard templates
- 8-week compatibility window + deprecation notices
- canary 10% traffic -> monitor error regressions

Priya (Console): I'll schedule a quick UX walkthrough with Maya and Alex next Tue.

Diego (SRE): I'll add dashboard panels for bucket rates + per-id drilldowns. include sample replay harness for console previews.
